title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
author: Henrique Schechter Vera, Sahil Dua, Jovan Andonov, Sara Smoot et al.

summary: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations.
takeaways: Notably, in comprehensive embedding benchmarks across all modalities, EmbeddingGemma 2 establishes a new Pareto frontier, outperforming both specialist models and models two to twelve times larger.
We present ablations analyzing key decisions and release EmbeddingGemma 2 to promote further research.

Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations.
